bio: Most of my time goes into Ryoku. I work on the shell, the installer, the package repos and the update system, and I go through the issues and pull requests people send in. Everything further down this page is part of Ryoku or ships with it.

work.desc: Every package on the machine in one list, across 46 package managers. Ryoku ships it as gpk.
The Ryoku store catalogue: widgets, plugins, lock screens and bundles from the community.
A local code index. Agents ask it where something lives and get the file and line back instead of reading whole files. Ships with Rashin.
The music player made for Ryoku. YouTube, Spotify and SoundCloud in one Quickshell app that changes colour with your wallpaper.
